ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Type Consumer
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Live fixture for issue #86. Declares several unconditional, unpatched <JoofTest.GadgetDef> instances -- a custom def type supplied by joof.testharness.typeprovider's own C# assembly, not this mod's. This mod is UNCHANGED between Run A and Run B: no patches touch these defs, no MayRequire anywhere. The whole point is that nothing about this mod's own files looks dirty by any existing seed -- the only thing that changes is whether joof.testharness.typeprovider (and therefore the JoofTest.GadgetDef Type) is present in the load. No game content — dev/QA use only.
